messages:
Liam (AE): ArcadiaTrust procurement wants SIG v3 Q-by-Q + artifacts for ENCR/ACCESS/INFRA. Deadline: Tue EOD. They flagged customer-managed keys and data residency as blockers.
Zoe (Security): Understood. Do they want full attachments for every question or only the flagged control families?
Liam (AE): Only ENCR/ACCESS/INFRA need attachments; full Q&A text for the rest is fine.
Harper (Solutions): I'll map questions -> artifacts. ETA Mon 10am. Which artifacts are mandatory?
Zoe (Security): Minimal: redacted SOC2 cover, KMS/HSM policy, key rotation runbook excerpt, DB+blob encryption config screenshots, SCIM provisioning sample, private-deploy network diagram, recent pen-test executive summary.
Ria (Legal): Reminder: redact tenant IDs, internal hostnames and IPs. Full SOC2 requires signed DPA before release. Use secure-share with short TTL.
evidence-bot: Uploaded: soc2_redacted_q2_2025.pdf, key_policy_hsm.pdf, rotation_runbook_snip.txt, network_diagram_private.png
Harper (Solutions): Draft answer for SIG 3.2.1 (key ownership): "We support customer-managed keys via cloud KMS and HSM integrations for Private/Dedicated deployments. Rotation is documented; follow SRE runbook." Good?
Zoe (Security): Add an ops snippet (Azure example) and soften absolute downtime language.
Zoe (Security): ```
# azure key vault example (illustrative)
az keyvault key create --vault-name arc-vault -n new-key
# update service config to new key URI
kubectl set env deploy/ri-service REDWOOD_KV_URI=https://arc-vault.vault.azure.net/keys/new-key
```
Ria (Legal): For wording, prefer: "no expected service disruption when following the documented rotation procedure." I'll insert into answers I review.
Liam (AE): Arcadia also asked about EU-only residency options. Can we confirm?
Zoe (Security): Confirmed: EU-only residency supported via Private or Dedicated region pinning; we'll attach screenshot and contractual note.
Harper (Solutions): I'll produce aurora_arcadia_sig_map_v1.xlsx (question->answer->artifact) and a README listing redactions. Plan: finalize answers + artifacts Mon 10am, Legal to review by Mon 3pm, Liam will deliver Tue morning.
Liam (AE): Perfect. Thanks everyone. evidence-bot, please prepare a single encrypted zip when final. :thumbsup:
